author: greenbottles10
quote:
Only hope for this game now is the online component but given how this launch has gone I wouldn’t get your hopes up just in case. 

One point for the VFX and effort they put into making the map. The rest of the game… not worth the wait of 13 years. 

The story is dull and nonsensical and to top it off the writing is completely awful and lazy. These are the worst main characters I have ever played with a story so poor you can’t even laugh at how bad it is.

Difficult to believe this is actually a game in the GTA franchise…
